name: Asana
description: Project management: work management platform for tasks, projects, portfolios and goals across teams.
access_notes: Asana has a free tier; any user can generate a personal access token from the developer console (app.asana.com/0/my-apps) and create OAuth apps self-serve. Service accounts require Enterprise plans, but PAT/OAuth do not.
mcp_notes: Official Asana MCP V2 server at https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp (GA, OAuth with app pre-registration in developer console; no dynamic client registration; V1 /sse endpoint deprecated). Composio has a managed ASANA toolkit (OAuth2, 153 tools, 6 triggers).

evidence.note: Documents PATs, OAuth (best for multi-user apps), OpenID Connect, and Service Accounts as auth options.
PATs generated self-serve in the developer console; used as Bearer tokens against app.asana.com/api/1.0 REST API.
POST /webhooks establishes webhooks with X-Hook-Secret handshake and HMAC signature verification.
Vendor docs for the official Asana MCP server accessing the Asana Work Graph.
V2 MCP server at mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp is generally available; OAuth with pre-registered MCP apps; no DCR.
Composio managed ASANA toolkit: OAuth2, 153 tools, 6 triggers.
